name: Contract attribute price
expected: AttributeBasedPrice step (ListContainer35 / ListOperation36, IsContractEnabled=true) fires when ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull; contracted Attribute PAS adjustment applies to NetUnitPrice, producing a different net than the catalog path
actual: Branch cannot fire. ItemContractAttributePasId is platform-managed and transient (customMappingAllowed=false); it is hydrated ONLY when the pricing engine resolves a contracted Attribute-type PriceAdjustmentSchedule. Org has 0 contracted Attribute PAS (ScheduleType=Attribute AND ContractId set): only 1 Attribute PAS exists (84Xa50000010nWQEAY 'Standard Attribute Based Adjustment', ContractId=null = catalog). Sole ContractItemPrice (1AuWC000002G4050AC CIP-0000000001, contract 800WC00000SFn6jYAD) is DiscountType=AdjustmentPercentage (10%), not attribute-based. Re-confirmed after V21 in-place edits of 2026-06-30: force-reprice of fixture quote 0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0 (isSuccess=true) shows contracted line 0QLWC000003kk694AA Net=1575 = same as catalog line 0QLWC000003kk6A4AQ Net=1575; Attribute_Price_Mode__c=null on both; the catalog Attribute PAS path (D-03) ran on both, confirming ItemContractAttributePasId was null.
evidence: Live V21 proc confirm: force-reprice /services/data/v67.0/connect/rev/sales-transaction/actions/place isSuccess=true errorResponse=[]; QLI query post-reprice: L1 (0QLWC000003kk694AA, PricingContractId=800WC00000SFn6jYAD) Net=1575 ListPrice=3150 Source_List_Price__c=1575 Base_Price__c=1575 Attribute_Price_Mode__c=null; L2 (0QLWC000003kk6A4AQ, no contract) Net=1575 ListPrice=3150 identical. PriceAdjustmentSchedule count=3: only 1 Attribute type (84Xa50000010nWQEAY ContractId=null, catalog). ContractItemPrice count=1 (1AuWC000002G4050AC, DiscountType=AdjustmentPercentage 10%, not attribute). Context def lines 22899/22906: ItemContractAttributePasId customMappingAllowed=false transient=true. Filter ListOperation36 (parentStep=ListContainer35): condition 1 = ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull — always false with no contracted Attribute PAS. Quote URL: https://fortra--uat.sandbox.lightning.force.com/lightning/r/Quote/0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0/view
proposedFix: To make D-06 exercisable: create a contracted Attribute PriceAdjustmentSchedule (PAS with ScheduleType=Attribute and ContractId pointing to an active contract, with matching PriceAdjustmentTier rows for the test product+attributes). Only then will the platform hydrate ItemContractAttributePasId on a contracted QLI, allowing ListOperation36 to pass and AttributeBasedPrice to fire. This is a missing org-config for a contracted-attribute pricing use case, not a procedure defect.
notes: D-06 contracted-attribute branch is structurally present in V21 (ListContainer35/ListOperation36: ItemContractAttributePasId IsNotNull AND ItemPricingSource!=LastTransaction AND DerivedPricingAttribute IsNotNull AND =false -> AttributeBasedPrice step, IsContractEnabled=true, LookUpApiName=Attribute_Based_Adjustment_Decision_Table). V21 in-place edits on 2026-06-30 did not change this branch. The blocker is purely that the org has never provisioned a contracted Attribute PAS: setting ScheduleType=Attribute with a ContractId requires a Salesforce-side data setup that is not part of Fortra's current pricing configuration. The root cause is classified ORG-CONFIG-DEFECT (not TEST-DATA-ARTIFACT) because a real sales rep / admin also cannot trigger this branch in the current org — the contracted attribute pricing feature is simply not configured in FortraUAT. This is consistent with run1 BLOCKED verdict; re-running on current V21 confirms no change. Comparison: D-03 catalog branch (AttributePASIdConstant / AttributeDiscountEntries, ListContainer38, IsContracted IsNull OR false) fires correctly on both lines (both show Net=1575 = 50% of list via the catalog Attribute PAS).
verdict_reason: Preflight FAIL: org has zero contracted Attribute PriceAdjustmentSchedule; ItemContractAttributePasId is always null (platform-managed, transient, customMappingAllowed=false); the D-06 contracted branch (ListOperation36 / AttributeBasedPrice) cannot be triggered by any fixture. Force-reprice of existing fixture quote 0Q0WC000003FaZJ0A0 confirms: contracted line and catalog line both net 1575 identically via the D-03 catalog path; Attribute_Price_Mode__c=null on both. Branch cannot be smoke-tested until a contracted Attribute PAS is provisioned in FortraUAT.
